title: Apple Pie
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

We have $A$ apples and $P$ pieces of apple.

We can cut an apple into three pieces of apple, and make one apple pie by simmering two pieces of apple in a pan.

Find the maximum number of apple pies we can make with what we have now.

## Constraints

- All values in input are integers.
- $0 \leq A, P \leq 100$

## Input

Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
A P
```

## Output

Print the maximum number of apple pies we can make with what we have.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

我们有 $A$ 个苹果和 $P$ 块苹果。

我们可以将一个苹果切成三块苹果，并将两块苹果放入平底锅中炖煮，制作一个苹果派。

求利用现有材料最多可以制作多少个苹果派。

## 约束条件

- 输入中的所有值均为整数。
- $0 \leq A, P \leq 100$

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
A P
```

## 输出格式

输出利用现有材料最多可以制作的苹果派数量。

samples.note: We can first make one apple pie by simmering two of the three pieces of apple. Then, we can make two more by simmering the remaining piece and three more pieces obtained by cutting the whole apple.
We cannot make an apple pie in this case, unfortunately.
